hints.title: Pairwise Swap Similarity
hints.text: Two anagrams are connected if they differ at exactly two character positions or are identical.

hints.title: Diff Count Predicate
hints.text: Compare two strings character-by-character; they are similar if the count of mismatched positions is at most two.

hints.title: Connected Component Metric
hints.text: Build disjoint sets over all string indices. For every pair of similar strings, unite their sets and return the total number of distinct roots.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: All-pairs similarity check with union-find component tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all L * (L - 1) / 2 two-swap word variations per string takes O(N * L^2) time which is slower when L is large.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent array of size N requires O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use union-find to group connected words and terminate mismatch count early after 2 diffs.
